hypotheses_under_test: H_eulerian: the DYNAMIC/Eulerian frame (a closed loop enclosing nonzero Berry curvature) has NONtrivial holonomy U_loop != I.
H_stokes: the nontrivial holonomy phase magnitude EQUALS the enclosed curvature flux Omega/2 (non-abelian Stokes / Berry); it is not a free number.
H_lagrangian: the DIRECT/Lagrangian/comoving frame (V(s)=I) has TRIVIAL holonomy U_loop = I (the path-ordered product telescopes to V(1)^dag V(0)).
H_trivial_loop: a TRIVIAL loop (contractible to a point, zero enclosed area) has TRIVIAL holonomy.

H_flat_control: a FLAT/pure-gauge connection around the SAME loop topology has TRIVIAL holonomy -- the value-coupled proof that the dynamic holonomy is forced by enclosed CURVATURE, not the loop alone (NOT by-construction).
H_shrink: shrinking the loop (enclosed area -> 0) drives the holonomy -> I continuously, tracking the enclosed flux.
H_gauge: the CLOSED-loop holonomy trace is gauge-invariant; ERASING the loop (open path) makes the 'holonomy' gauge-DEPENDENT.
